title: My membership says 'No internet' while it is still loading
what: Every time the Gym tab opens, the card first shows the plan kept on the phone with its 'kept' time, so the line 'No internet. As of 6:42 pm today.' shows until the gym answers, even with good internet (up to 15 seconds on a slow line).
expected: The kept plan shows without the 'No internet' line while the fresh answer is on its way; the line shows only after a call really failed for lack of internet.
fix_line: Show the kept plan with keptAt null until the call fails offline
